pages.title: Filling Your Stomach
pages.text: Poop Bread, Poop Dumplings, and Poopsicles are basic filth foods.$(br2)They provide a steady food source in the early game and make great rations for your skyblock start.
Some filth foods can be processed further, turning basic ingredients into heartier filth meals.$(br2)Check JEI for the exact crafting recipes.
